title: facub8's Christmas Mod
description: A Christmas mod made by facub8
body:
**Use of internal data such as textures and models is PROHIBITED.**
 

This mod brings the magic of Christmas into your world!

It introduces Santa, a neutral mob, along with his Elves, who are allies of Santa and help protect the spirit of Christmas. The Grinch, on the other hand, is a hostile mob determined to destroy Christmas.

**Features:**


The world becomes colder, causing snow to fall instead of rain.

Throughout the world, you can find Christmas trees with gifts. Breaking these gifts gives a random item.

The mod also adds a special Christmas Biome, where:

Santa, Elves, and the Grinch spawn more frequently
Candy Canes generate naturally
Candy Canes are made of Candy Blocks, which can be crafted into Candies.

Candies are a consumable item that grants Speed and Haste effects. They can be obtained by:

Crafting them from Candy Blocks
Cooking sugar in a furnace
The Grinch and Santa will fight when they meet.
